result.authors: ['Marek Novotny', ' Jana Kralova', ' David P. Ruiz']
result.keywords: This article studies model-free critic-only reinforcement learning in continuous and metric state-action spaces, combining adaptive discretization with policy derivation methods to improve sample efficiency and stability under episodic and continuous control settings. The proposed approach maintains data-driven partitions that refine high-visit regions while preserving performance guarantees, and it is evaluated against uniform discretization baselines and related Q-learning variants.
result.title: Adaptive Policy Partitioning for Critic-Only Reinforcement Learning in Metric Spaces
